final: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS overall_avg FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL), first_cut AS (SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_len FROM rating_avgs ra, overall_avg oa WHERE ra.avg_len > oa.overall_avg), first_cut_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_len) AS mean_first_cut FROM first_cut), final_cut AS (SELECT fc.rating, fc.avg_len FROM first_cut fc, first_cut_mean fcm WHERE fc.avg_len > fcm.mean_first_cut) SELECT AVG(fc.avg_len) AS mean_remaining, AVG(fc.avg_len - oa.overall_avg) AS above_overall, AVG(fc.avg_len - fcm.mean_first_cut) AS above_first_cut_mean FROM final_cut fc, overall_avg oa, first_cut_mean fcm
